data.title: Warehouse stock count always crashes
story: The total_stock function adds up the stock on every warehouse shelf, but every call ends in an IndexError.
Run the tests, read the last line of the error, then check the loop's limit.

explanation: List indexes run from 0 to len(stock) - 1, so range(len(stock) + 1) tries to read one item that does not exist and raises an IndexError. Just use range(len(stock)).
hints: An IndexError means the code asked for a position that is not in the list.
The list [5, 3, 2] has indexes 0, 1, 2. Which numbers does range(len(stock) + 1) produce?
